judgments.verdict: The board turns touch into capacity refusals, fresh rehearsals and receipts while felt generativity and joy remain untested.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world to make fast generation touchable through resistance where intention becomes recognizable. Reading: The artefact enacts that as ask, proposal, rehearsal and enactment with inspectable refusals and trails, though flood and joy are absent. Other levels: Below as level-2 fits the missing naming and joy; above as level-4 would need a real encounter sustaining alternatives, falsified until first-contact records an observed result.

judgments.verdict: The board makes refusal and provenance inspectable, yet the felt meeting of intention and material is explicitly deferred to a future real question.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether power can become touch through a loop where resistance returns intention to the maker. Reading: The artefact builds refusal, rehearsal and trail into working structure but marks programmer experience as still unknown with first-contact still active. Other levels: Below would hold if only portal words survived without working refusal; above would need an observed real question with recognized consequence; such an observation record would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: The board turns effortless generation versus loss of touch into capacity, rehearsal and evidence rules with a concrete next encounter.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a world can restore touch when power arrives faster than the hand can feel. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into connected choices around attention, rehearsal and trails, though companion reciprocity is missing. Other levels: Below fits motif repetition alone, above would need felt recognition demonstrated; one real encounter with observed joy would falsify the cap.

judgments.verdict: All shaping acts belong to one operator while the engine only enforces rules without its own purpose.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a portal becoming a participant that brings its own position to shared shaping. Reading: The artefact provides an instrument where one operator asks and enacts and the board merely permits or blocks. Other levels: Below as level-0 would need no roles at all, refuted by operator versus board; above as level-2 would need a distinct second contribution, falsified unless a successor or intelligence proposal appears.

judgments.verdict: Only the human operator proposes and enacts; the engine refuses under law but contributes no purpose of its own.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a meeting where each of person, intelligence and material brings purpose and can shape the outcome. Reading: Here one operator holds all gestures while the workbench enforces laws; blocked verdicts show resistance but not another contributor. Other levels: Below would hold if even refusal were absent; above would need a second participant proposing or challenging with its own reasons; a receipt authored from another position would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: One operator acts on a rule-bound board; material refuses but no intelligence contributes from its own position.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for two participants meeting in a material that answers both. Reading: Only the human can question, accept or withdraw while the board enforces limits, so the work is an instrument with resistance. Other levels: Level-2 could fit the board as distinct contributor, level-0 would deny even that; an intelligence able to propose or refuse would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Only the operator can steer, park or resolve while lock contention is the sole refusal without bilateral agreement.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a shared direction open only when each side can accept, limit or withdraw. Reading: The artefact lets the operator defer and reopen with history preserved, but no second position can question or refuse a direction. Other levels: Below as level-0 would need no boundary at all, refuted by evidence and capacity rules; above as level-2 would need a second boundary, falsified unless memory-correction or successor dissent is recorded.

judgments.verdict: The operator may start, park, resolve and reopen while lock and laws may refuse, but no second will must agree for change.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for shared change that opens only when both accept and each can limit or withdraw. Reading: The artefact shows operator choice plus resource refusal and revisable history, but enactment needs only a fresh pass from law, not agreement. Other levels: Below would hold if participation had no boundary at all; above would need bilateral expression and joint acceptance; a required acceptance by another named participant would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Operator parking, reopening and precedence plus lock and refusal handling show choice and resource limits without bilateral agreement.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a shared change open only when both accept and each can limit or withdraw. Reading: The artefact lets one side defer or revisit and lets the engine refuse, but no second position can consent. Other levels: Below would be no boundary at all, above would need mutual acceptance; a proposal requiring intelligence acceptance would falsify this.

judgments.verdict: Proposals must pass fresh rehearsals against current revision, making blocked and stale verdicts revise the next move.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a contribution meet resistance and return its consequence into the next choice. Reading: Capacity blocks, evidence demands and staleness on material change form a tested loop that forces re-rehearsal before enactment. Other levels: Below as level-2 would be merely inspectable choice, understating the loop; above as level-4 would need board consequences linked to wider programmer work, falsified until a real question is enacted and observed.

judgments.verdict: Propose, blocked or passing rehearsal, and fresh enactment with stale detection form a working loop that returns refusal into the next move.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a try can meet resistance, show consequence and feed that consequence into revised choice. Reading: Stale, blocked and passing rehearsals plus revision-gated enactment and logged observations enact that loop on the board. Other levels: Below would hold if feedback were only narrated; above would need board consequences tied to wider programmer work; an observed propagation beyond the board would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Propose, rehearsed verdict, enactment and observation link resistance to revision with stale checks and visible trails.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a loop where intention meets resistance and its consequence returns into the next choice. Reading: Blocked and passing rehearsals, stale revision rules and observations form that coherent loop, though felt joy stays untested. Other levels: Below is narrated feedback, above needs local and wider effects linked; a recorded programmer encounter changing the next proposal would support the higher case.

judgments.verdict: The maker commits to a minimal replayable board and one invited real question with tradeoffs and limits made explicit.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for taste and judgment that narrows infinity toward a world worth making. Reading: The artefact grounds medium, scope and next step in available zsh, provisional laws and an invitation that refuses to invent the programmer project. Other levels: Below as level-2 would be relevant direction alone, understating the rationale; above as level-4 would need alternatives weighed while opening a new direction, falsified until a domain is chosen and revisited.

judgments.verdict: The maker chose a small replayable board, named provisional limits and past repairs, and left the next domain to the programmer.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for shaping of laws and discerning questions rather than placing every brick. Reading: Decisions record why attention, replay, narrow vocabulary and portability were chosen, what broke, and what stays open. Other levels: Below would hold if choices lacked grounding in the story; above would need explicit alternatives weighed and a new grounded direction opened; a hidden invented project for the programmer would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: A small zsh board, one active place and a single real-question step are explained as testable attention tools with open unknowns.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for shaping laws that let a vast material stay touchable at both scales. Reading: Medium, scope and next step have a coherent grounded rationale tied to testability and resumption. Other levels: Below is weak seed linkage, above needs explicit alternatives weighed; documented rejected media or capacities would falsify the cap.

judgments.verdict: Core gestures become executable checks and files with bilateral depth narrowed and limits openly marked.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that question, constraint, invariant, boundary, rehearsal and receipt become structure for either participant. Reading: Several survive as ask, laws, capacity refusal, rehearse and event while companion mutuality and joy do not, with narrowing declared. Other levels: Below as level-2 fits if admin narrowing dominates; above as level-4 would need preserved relational depth plus explicit additions, falsified unless a second purpose appears in behavior.

judgments.verdict: Probe, chisel, beam, boundary, rehearsal and trail become commands and checks, while companion presence and felt joy fall away explicitly.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for transformation where relations survive in behaviour even with its words removed. Reading: Several gestures survive as enforced transitions and receipts with additions and narrowing made explicit, though joint agency narrows to instrument. Other levels: Below would hold if only vocabulary survived; above would need relational depth plus preserved disagreement across changes; a second participant shaping laws would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Gestures, trails, resistance and openness become working structure while companion mutuality and joy narrow to procedure and unknown.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives when parable becomes workbench without collapsing into mere vocabulary. Reading: Several relations stay traceable in behavior, with narrowing and additions made explicit in decisions and scope notes. Other levels: Below is words without structure, above needs full relational depth preserved; enacted companion acceptance would support the higher case.

judgments.verdict: A newcomer can verify, read history and handoff, and resume from files as proven by the file-only copy.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed leaves the relation open for a successor to recover intention and redirect it. Reading: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable move without a live process, with earlier work legible in log and receipts. Other levels: Below as level-2 would be durable but narrow storage alone, understating the handoff; above as level-4 would need several grounded directions reopening the joint relation, falsified until multiple questions are enacted.

judgments.verdict: Verify, status, log, ledger and handoff let a newcomer rebuild state and take one bounded next step without trusting memory.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed leaves the tale open for a future asker to decide the next move with earlier work legible. Reading: State, intention and an open question are recoverable from files alone, proven by a file-only copy, with a concrete next encounter named. Other levels: Below would hold if only a step were described without usable entry; above would need several grounded directions reopening the joint relation; a second queued encounter actually enacted would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Replayed receipts, entrance commands, handoff and proven file copy let a successor recover state and redirect work legibly.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for an ending that answers without closing and invites the next teller. Reading: State, intention and an open real-question step support a recoverable move with history intact. Other levels: Below is a described step without entry, above needs several directions reopening the joint relation; a second enacted question line would support the higher case.

judgments.verdict: Docs, laws, receipts and status with log together stage a legible encounter where resistance can be inspected in use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where what a true question contains becomes perceptible, not merely named. Reading: Commands, refusals, trails and guidance cohere around one bounded use that can be run and read without extra tools. Other levels: Below as level-2 would be fragments only, refuted by the working loop; above as level-4 would need consequential interaction as an accessible whole, falsified unless a real programmer encounter is observed.

judgments.verdict: Docs, laws, ledger format and terse commands together make constraint and trail legible in plain zsh without extra display.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for radiance bent into touchable form where asking and exploring are perceptible as making. Reading: Entrance texts, state diagram, status and log render the narrow reading coherently through use. Other levels: Below would hold if fragments communicated without usable form; above would need consequential interaction accessible beyond the restricted shell with felt encounter shown; a successful programmer encounter record would falsify this choice.

judgments.verdict: Docs, laws, commands and logs use a plain shared language so the intended meeting is perceptible in use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where questioning and resistance can be felt, not only named. Reading: Language, structure and interaction work together to show probes, refusals and trails in practice. Other levels: Below is fragmented motif talk, above needs interaction and expression as one accessible whole; a lived encounter record would support the higher case.

Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour. Aggregate outcome: level-3.

The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible. Aggregate outcome: level-3.

presentation.title: From conjecture to continuation
presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: A single operator acts on an instrument.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Rehearsal, resistance and revision form a coherent loop.
Independent judgment: Medium, scope and choices have a coherent source-grounded rationale.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible.
